items.source: This property is primarily supported for configuration compatibility with DefaultMessageListenerContainer. For this local listener container, generally use setConcurrentConsumers(int) instead.
items.translation: 此属性主要用于与DefaultMessageListenerContainer的配置兼容性。对于此本地监听器容器，通常应使用setConcurrentConsumers(int)。

items.source: NOTE: Concurrent listener execution via a TaskExecutor will lead to concurrent processing of messages that have been received by the same underlying Session. As a consequence, it is not recommended to use this setting with a SessionAwareMessageListener, at least not if the latter performs actual work on the given Session. A standard MessageListener will work fine, in general.
items.translation: 注意：通过 TaskExecutor 并发执行监听器将导致由同一底层 Session 接收的消息被并发处理。 因此，不建议将此设置与 SessionAwareMessageListener 一起使用，尤其是当后者对给定的 Session 执行实际工作时。通常情况下，标准的 MessageListener 可以正常工作。

items.source: For a different style of MessageListener handling, through looped MessageConsumer.receive() calls that also allow for transactional receipt of messages (registering them with XA transactions), see DefaultMessageListenerContainer.
items.translation: 对于另一种消息监听器处理风格，通过循环调用MessageConsumer.receive()（同时也允许事务性接收消息（将其注册到 XA 事务中）），请参阅DefaultMessageListenerContainer。

items.source: See the AbstractMessageListenerContainer javadoc for details on acknowledge modes and transaction options. Note that this container exposes standard JMS behavior for the default "AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE" mode: that is, automatic message acknowledgment after listener execution, with no redelivery in case of a user exception thrown but potential redelivery in case of the JVM dying during listener execution.
items.translation: 有关确认模式和事务选项的详细信息，请参阅 AbstractMessageListenerContainer 的 JavaDoc。请注意，此容器针对默认的"AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE"模式暴露了标准的 JMS 行为：即在监听器执行后自动确认消息；如果用户抛出异常则不会重新投递，但如果 JVM 在监听器执行期间崩溃则可能会重新投递。

items.source: This listener container will always hold on to the maximum number of consumers setConcurrentConsumers(int) since it is unable to scale.
items.translation: 此监听器容器由于无法扩展，将始终持有最大数量的消费者 setConcurrentConsumers(int)。

items.source: Do not raise the number of concurrent consumers for a topic. This would lead to concurrent consumption of the same message, which is hardly ever desirable.
items.translation: 请勿增加主题的并发消费者数量。 这会导致同一消息被并发消费，而这几乎总是不合意的。

items.source: NOTE: Specifying a TaskExecutor for listener execution affects acknowledgement semantics. Messages will then always get acknowledged before listener execution, with the underlying Session immediately reused for receiving the next message. Using this in combination with a transacted session or with client acknowledgement will lead to unspecified results!
items.translation: 注意：为监听器执行指定 TaskExecutor 会影响确认语义。 消息将总是在监听器执行之前得到确认，底层的 Session 会立即被重用用于接收下一条消息。将此与事务性会话或客户端确认结合使用会导致未定义的结果！

items.source:
This is the simplest form of a message listener container.
It creates a fixed number of JMS Sessions to invoke the listener,
not allowing for dynamic adaptation to runtime demands. Its main
advantage is its low level of complexity and the minimum requirements
on the JMS provider: Not even the ServerSessionPool facility is required.
items.translation: 这是消息监听器容器的最简单形式。它创建固定数量的 JMS Session 来调用监听器，无法根据运行时需求进行动态调整。其主要优势在于复杂度低以及对 JMS 提供者的要求最小：甚至不需要 ServerSessionPool 设施。

items.source:
Default is "false": connecting early, i.e. during the bean initialization phase.
Set this flag to "true" in order to switch to lazy connecting if your target broker
is likely to not have started up yet and you prefer to not even try a connection.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"：即提前连接，也就是在 Bean 初始化阶段进行连接。如果目标 Broker 可能尚未启动，且您希望完全不尝试建立连接，请将此标志设置为 "true" 以切换到延迟连接模式。

items.source:
Default is "true": refreshing the shared connection and re-initializing the
consumers whenever the connection propagates an exception to its listener.
Set this flag to "false" in order to rely on automatic recovery within the
provider, holding on to the existing connection and consumer handles.
items.translation: 默认为"true"：当连接向其监听器传播异常时，刷新共享连接并重新初始化消费者。将此标志设置为"false"以依赖提供程序内的自动恢复，保留现有的连接和消费者句柄。

items.source:
Default is none, that is, to run in the JMS provider's own receive thread,
blocking the provider's receive endpoint while executing the listener.
items.translation: 默认值为 none，即在 JMS 提供程序自身的接收线程中运行，在执行监听器时阻塞提供程序的接收端点。

items.source:
Specify a TaskExecutor for executing the listener in a different thread,
rather than blocking the JMS provider, usually integrating with an existing
thread pool. This allows to keep the number of concurrent consumers low (1)
while still processing messages concurrently (decoupled from receiving!).
items.translation: 为在不同线程中执行监听器指定一个 TaskExecutor，而不是阻塞 JMS 提供者，通常通过集成现有的线程池来实现。这允许将并发消费者的数量保持在较低水平（1），同时仍能并发处理消息（与接收解耦！）。

items.source:
Executes the listener, exposing the current JMS Session as
thread-bound resource (if "exposeListenerSession" is "true").
items.translation: 执行监听器，将当前的 JMS Session 暴露为线程绑定资源（如果"exposeListenerSession"为"true"）。

items.source:
Create a MessageConsumer for the given JMS Session,

items.translation: 为给定的 JMS Session 创建一个 MessageConsumer，并为指定的监听器注册一个 MessageListener。

items.source:
Creates the specified number of concurrent consumers,
in the form of a JMS Session plus associated MessageConsumer.
items.translation: 创建指定数量的并发消费者，形式为 JMS 会话及其关联的 MessageConsumer。

items.source: Destroy the registered JMS Sessions and associated MessageConsumers.
items.translation: 销毁已注册的 JMS 会话及相关消息消费者。

items.translation: 如果尚未初始化，则重新初始化此容器的 JMS 消息消费者。

items.translation: 为此容器初始化 JMS 会话和消息消费者。

items.translation: 将此监听器容器注册为共享连接上的 JMS 异常监听器。

items.source: Always use a shared JMS Connection.
items.translation: 始终使用共享的 JMS 连接。

items.source:
JMS ExceptionListener implementation, invoked by the JMS provider in
case of connection failures. Re-initializes this listener container's
shared connection and its sessions and consumers, if necessary.
items.translation: JMS 异常监听器实现，在发生连接故障时由 JMS 提供者调用。如有必要，将重新初始化此监听容器的共享连接及其会话和消费者。

items.source:
Raising the number of concurrent consumers is recommendable in order
to scale the consumption of messages coming in from a queue. However,
note that any ordering guarantees are lost once multiple consumers are
registered. In general, stick with 1 consumer for low-volume queues.
items.translation: 为了提高从队列中消费消息的吞吐量，建议增加并发消费者的数量。但请注意，一旦注册多个消费者，任何顺序保证都将丢失。通常情况下，对于低流量队列，请坚持使用单个消费者。
